record.provider: HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne, CCSD / CNRS)

free_tier.stated: 200 MB maximum per file in the deposit UI, plus a 5 GB per-account FTP staging space that is provisional only: 'pour une durée provisoire pouvant aller jusqu'à 31 jours maximum'. No aggregate storage quota is published.

retention.stated: | Very stable national infrastructure (CCSD/CNRS) with permanent URLs, but the per-file 200 MB cap and the bibliographic-record model make it useless for bulk blobs; the 5 GB FTP space decays in 31 days.

egress.terms: Free public PDF/fulltext download, no metering; metadata is harvested by OpenAIRE, BASE, Google Scholar.

record.tooling: Deposit API + SWORD for programmatic submission (api.archives-ouvertes.fr/docs), FTP staging at ftp.ccsd.cnrs.fr with explicit TLS (FileZilla), OAI-PMH, and a TripleStore. This is a genuinely automatable write path.
record.chaining: Unlimited deposits x 200 MB/file. 2,500 files for 500 GB, but each deposit is a bibliographic notice, so the multiplier is records not blobs. 5 GB FTP staging expires in 31 days.

limits.value: transfer is limited to 3 MB/file and 10 MB total

record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 200 MB (soft, varies with traffic); FTP staging 5 GB / 31 days; the deposit must be a scholarly document with a document type, so raw data blobs are out of scope. arXiv transfer is limited to 3 MB/file and 10 MB total.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'academic'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

record.reliability_note: Very stable national infrastructure (CCSD/CNRS) with permanent URLs, but the per-file 200 MB cap and the bibliographic-record model make it useless for bulk blobs; the 5 GB FTP space decays in 31 days.

evidence.proved: 'La taille maximum d'un fichier est de 200Mo'; mentions the FTP staging space as the alternative route for larger sets

evidence.quote: La taille maximum d’un fichier est de 200Mo. A noter que cette taille peut varier légèrement en fonction du trafic sur HAL.

evidence.proved: the FTP staging space is 5 GB per account and is provisional for at most 31 days
evidence.quote: Chaque compte utilisateur dispose d’un espace de 5 Go sur le serveur FTP du CCSD. Cet espace permet de stocker des fichiers quel que soit leur format. Vos documents seront disponibles dans votre espace FTP pour une durée provisoire pouvant aller jusqu'à 31 jours maximum.
